%%                                                                   %%
%%  REFERENCES:                                                      %%
%%   Z. Yang, B.-C. Wang (2018):                                     %%
%%   "Capturing Taylor-Gortler vortices in a streamwiser-rotating    %%
%%   channel at very high rotation numbers", J. Fluid Mech.,         %%
%%   vol. 838, pp. 658-689, doi:10.1017/jfm.2017.892                 %%
%%                                                                   %%
%%  NOMENCLATURE:                                                    %%
%%   y = wall-normal coordinate                                      %%
%%   h = channel half-width                                          %%
%%   tau_w = mean Wall shear stress                                  %%
%%   u_tau = sqrt(tau_w / rho) = friction velocity                   %%
%%   nu = kinematic viscosity                                        %%
%%   Omega = angular velocity of system rotation                     %%
%%   Re_tau = u_tau*h/nu = Reynolds number                           %%
%%   Ro_tau = 2Omega*h/u_tau = Rotation number                       %%
%%   < > = time and plane average                                    %%
%%   U = mean streamwise velocity                                    %%
%%   W = mean spanwise velocity                                      %%
%%   u, v, w = streamwise, wall-normal, and spanwise                 %%
%%             velocity fluctuations                                 %%
%%   (.)+ = normalized by utau and nu                                %%
%%                                                                   %%
%%                                                                   %%
%%   produc = production term                                        %%
%%   rot = rotation term                                             %%
%%   p-strain = pressure-strain correlation term                     %%
%%   dissip = dissipation term                                       %%
%%   t-diff = turbulence diffusion term                              %%
%%   p-diff = pressure diffusion term                                %%
%%   v-diff = viscous diffusion term                                 %%
%%   res = residual of the balance                                   %%
%%   See equations (7.4)-(7.10) in Yang & Wang (2018) for the        %%
%%   definitions of the budget terms                                 %%
%%                                                                   %%
%%                                                                   %%
%%  FLOW CONDITIONS:   Re_tau = 180                                  %%
%%                     Ro_tau = 15                                   %%
%%  Case # in Yang and Wang (2018): B                                %%
%%                                                                   %%
%%  BOX SIZE (x,y,z): 64pi*h|2h|8pi*h                                %%
%%  MESH NUMBER (x,y,z): 2048|128|512                                %%
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

%%  y/h        U+        W+         <uu>+        <vv>+           <ww>+          <uv>+          <uw>+           <vw>+         TKE+       produc_uu+         rot_uu+        p-strain_uu+     dissip_uu+         t-diff_uu+       p-diff_uu+       v-diff_uu+        res_uu+      produc_vv+         rot_vv+        p-strain_vv+     dissip_vv+         t-diff_vv+       p-diff_vv+       v-diff_vv+        res_vv+      produc_ww+         rot_ww+        p-strain_ww+     dissip_ww+         t-diff_ww+       p-diff_ww+       v-diff_ww+        res_ww+      produc_uv+         rot_uv+        p-strain_uv+     dissip_uv+         t-diff_uv+       p-diff_uv+       v-diff_uv+        res_uv+      produc_uw+         rot_uw+        p-strain_uw+     dissip_uw+         t-diff_uw+       p-diff_uw+       v-diff_uw+        res_uw+      produc_vw+         rot_vw+        p-strain_vw+     dissip_vw+         t-diff_vw+       p-diff_vw+       v-diff_vw+        res_vw+
